g.text: Tariff rates on U.S. imports by trading partner, 2017–2026

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Monthly. The statutory rate weights the rates in force by same-month imports; the effective rate is what was assessed at entry.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: All panels share the left scale except China, which is on its own scale (right).

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: EU: 27 current members throughout. Latest month: August 2026. Effective rates are as assessed at entry, before the 2026 IEEPA refunds.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, international trade (imports for consumption, calculated duties); tariff orders compiled from the Federal Register and HTSUS (tariff_actions.csv).
